trust_boundaries.protocol: disabled by default; local capture in CI
bounded HTTP to fixed loopback/allowlisted service; no proxy or redirect
allowlisted projection, opaque references and strict schema validation
sanitized audit metadata over verified GELF HTTPS; authenticated metrics and probe

applicability_decisions.rationale: Remote imports and user-provided webhook destinations are absent. This decision does not cover AI runtime or other configured outbound transports; runtime SSRF is modeled in R-37.
applicability_decisions.reopen_condition: Reassess before adding remote imports, RPA connectors, webhooks or user-controlled network destinations.

risks.threat: Credential stuffing or user enumeration compromises an identity.
Access or refresh token replay extends unauthorized access.
controls: Access token held only in memory
No automatic replay of non-idempotent requests
Public and authenticated shells are mutually exclusive

risks.threat: Production lacks an approved corporate identity provider while local login remains restricted to non-production environments.
controls: Local login blocked by production configuration
Identity provider gate documented in ADR 0001
Fail-closed claims contract with synthetic examples
Reviewed group-to-role mapping, no automatic provisioning
Temporary local login with a mandatory end date outside production
Decision register with owner and state for every identity gate
risks.decision: Production deployment remains blocked until the corporate identity gate is approved.

risks.threat: A disguised, active or compressed malicious upload reaches processing or public storage.
controls: Extension, MIME, signature and decoded-format validation

risks.threat: Filename or storage key manipulation escapes the controlled directory.
controls: Client filename is not used as a physical path

risks.threat: Large or repeated uploads exhaust CPU, memory or storage.
An identifier or filter accesses a resource outside the effective organization scope.
controls: Total Decision source ORG_ID stays separate from IAM authorization scope

risks.threat: Injection through search, filters or identifiers changes a database query.
Unbounded search, pagination or reprocessing degrades the service or duplicates work.
controls: Shared search and reprocessing rate limits

risks.threat: Report detail or export leaks another organization's snapshot or internal metadata.
controls: Distinct read, generate and export permissions

risks.threat: Exported text executes as a spreadsheet formula or report history is overwritten.
Repeated report generation or export exhausts database and application resources.
controls: Shared generation and export rate limits
Measured rupture envelope and explicit capacity gate
risks.decision: Functional integrity passed at the reference volume; target capacity and SLO approval remain a corporate gate before Stage 6.

risks.threat: A notification is exposed to the wrong user or organization.
controls: No notification body in delivery audit

risks.threat: Repeated workers duplicate delivery or stale work finalizes another worker's attempt.
Corporate provider credentials or message content leak through configuration, persistence or logs.
controls: No credentials in database or repository
risks.reopen_condition: Before enabling a corporate provider, approve secret custody, recipient policy and operational monitoring.

risks.threat: A requester self-approves or an ineligible reviewer decides outside policy or organization.
controls: Distinct submit, assign and decide permissions

risks.threat: Concurrent decisions, mutable policy or overwritten history changes the approved outcome.
A decision lacks attributable justification, consent, session or policy version.
Mass assignment or an unauthorized association grants administrative or cross-organization access.
Administrative or operational audit data is altered, deleted or unavailable during investigation.
risks.decision: Automated recovery evidence exists; independent runbook execution remains an acceptance gate.

risks.threat: Logs, metrics, errors or CI artifacts expose tokens, hashes, paths or operational content.
controls: No raw access URL or absolute storage path
Total Decision minimizes user and remark values to presence before pipeline artifacts; dry-run reports contain only counts

risks.threat: The system cannot detect dependency degradation or recover data after database or storage failure.
controls: Versioned alerts with firing and recovery tests
risks.decision: Detection and synthetic controlled recovery are implemented; corporate destination, RPO, RTO and SLO remain external acceptance gates.

risks.threat: A vulnerable dependency, leaked secret or compromised build artifact enters the release.
risks.decision: Confirmed high and critical findings block the release unless a complete, time-bounded exception is registered.

risks.threat: The initial reviewer group or decision policy is mistaken for final corporate authority levels.
controls: Documentation states that corporate authority levels are not represented
New rules require a new version
risks.reopen_condition: Before production approval workflows, business owners must approve reviewer groups, authority levels and consent rules.

risks.threat: Permissive CORS, cache or browser policy exposes authenticated responses or allows untrusted content execution.
controls: Angular interpolation escapes text by default
Access token held only in memory
CSP and browser headers on the production Angular build
No-store policy on sensitive API responses
risks.decision: CORS, CSP, security headers and sensitive-response cache policy passed the automated release regression.

risks.threat: Stored or reflected operational content executes script in an authenticated browser context.
controls: Angular interpolation escapes text by default
No dynamic innerHTML or trust-bypass API
DAST reflection probes and published-build browser regression
risks.decision: CSP and executable-content regressions passed; future dynamic rendering must reopen this assessment.

risks.threat: A hostile origin induces refresh, logout or another cookie-backed session action without user intent.
controls: Refresh cookie uses HttpOnly and SameSite Strict
Credentialed CORS uses an explicit origin allowlist
Business mutations require an in-memory Bearer token

risks.threat: An identity provider outage blocks sign-in or pushes operators toward a local-login bypass.
controls: Provider outage rejects new sign-ins without a local fallback in production
Valid sessions continue until expiry and renewal does not call the provider
Activation runbook with an outage procedure

risks.threat: Forged, stale or mis-mapped claims or groups grant organizations or roles the person should not have.
controls: Issuer, audience, expiry, subject, verified e-mail and MFA validated before mapping
Groups grant nothing outside a reviewed mapping table with exact matching
Global roles require an explicit review mark
Unknown organizations are ignored and an empty scope rejects the identity
Users are linked by an administrator, never created from a claim

risks.threat: A person removed in the corporate directory keeps SYNERGIA access until the session expires.
controls: Deactivate and block revoke SYNERGIA sessions immediately
Access token lifetime of 15 minutes bounds the remaining window
Rotating refresh tokens with idle and absolute limits
risks.decision: Production use of corporate sign-in stays blocked until the offboarding SLA and a synchronization mechanism are defined (ID-P03).

risks.threat: Temporary local login remains enabled after the corporate adapter is accepted.
controls: Local login is ignored in production
Homologation requires a timezone-aware end date within 90 days and refuses sign-in after it
Removal is a step of the adapter acceptance runbook

risks.threat: Stored source values, reasons, justifications or names contain instructions.
risks.origin: Stored source values, reasons, justifications or names contain instructions.
controls: Read-only allowlisted SQL projection excludes free-text fields; bounded closed vocabularies; no tools or business write capability.
Only empty POST body; versioned context and grounded output validation.
Closed context/rejection codes, sanitized logs and deterministic fallback.
preventive_controls: Read-only allowlisted SQL projection excludes free-text fields; bounded closed vocabularies; no tools or business write capability.
Only empty POST body; versioned context and grounded output validation.
detective_controls: Closed context/rejection codes, sanitized logs and deterministic fallback.
risks.residual_risk: Compromised trusted catalog/config or an allowed structured value can still influence wording; this is not a general solution to prompt injection.

risks.threat: Authenticated caller supplies an execution from another organization.
risks.origin: Authenticated caller supplies an execution from another organization.
controls: Intersect execution and assistance scopes in the backend, scoped subject read before details, tenant/context-bound persisted results.
404 without enumeration; confirmed scope violation signal and authorization audit; critical alert.
preventive_controls: Intersect execution and assistance scopes in the backend, scoped subject read before details, tenant/context-bound persisted results.
detective_controls: 404 without enumeration; confirmed scope violation signal and authorization audit; critical alert.
risks.residual_risk: Privileged database/identity compromise can bypass application scopes; global grants remain privileged.

risks.threat: Context, exception details, model text or high-cardinality identifiers reach observability.
risks.origin: Context, exception details, model text or high-cardinality identifiers reach observability.
controls: Minimized context excludes names, emails, reasons and original values; log allowlist, closed metric labels, sanitized audit projection.
Automated canary inspection across prompt, logs, metrics, result, audit and outbox; PostgreSQL/Graylog reconciliation.
preventive_controls: Minimized context excludes names, emails, reasons and original values; log allowlist, closed metric labels, sanitized audit projection.
detective_controls: Automated canary inspection across prompt, logs, metrics, result, audit and outbox; PostgreSQL/Graylog reconciliation.
risks.residual_risk: Authorized structured business facts and approved identifiers still reach the local runtime or restricted audit; host dumps and operator exports need separate custody.

risks.threat: Runtime returns HTML, script, URL or command disguised as an explanation.
risks.origin: Runtime returns HTML, script, URL or command disguised as an explanation.
controls: Strict output/grounding contract rejects invalid content before persistence; Angular interpolation and fixed internal reference navigation, no innerHTML.
Rejection code and deterministic fallback; Angular DOM tests render adversarial text literally.
preventive_controls: Strict output/grounding contract rejects invalid content before persistence; Angular interpolation and fixed internal reference navigation, no innerHTML.
detective_controls: Rejection code and deterministic fallback; Angular DOM tests render adversarial text literally.
risks.residual_risk: Future rich-text rendering or free external links reopen this boundary; validation cannot establish factual truth.

risks.threat: Configured runtime, weights or an advertised mutable model changes.
risks.origin: Configured runtime, weights or an advertised mutable model changes.
controls: Pinned version, installed/loaded digest and digest-named inference; verify before and after generation; no tool calls/thinking accepted.
runtime_pin_mismatch and critical integrity alert; authenticated version/tags probe without inference.
preventive_controls: Pinned version, installed/loaded digest and digest-named inference; verify before and after generation; no tool calls/thinking accepted.
detective_controls: runtime_pin_mismatch and critical integrity alert; authenticated version/tags probe without inference.
risks.residual_risk: Runtime can lie about version/digest if its host is compromised; no cryptographic host attestation is claimed.

risks.threat: Operator configuration, runtime redirect or proxy tries to send requests outside the approved origin.
risks.origin: Operator configuration, runtime redirect or proxy tries to send requests outside the approved origin.
controls: Validate HTTP origin without credentials/path/query/fragment; loopback or exact approved service; fixed routes; ProxyHandler empty and redirects refused.
Closed redirect/unavailable codes, authenticated probe and configuration gate.
preventive_controls: Validate HTTP origin without credentials/path/query/fragment; loopback or exact approved service; fixed routes; ProxyHandler empty and redirects refused.
detective_controls: Closed redirect/unavailable codes, authenticated probe and configuration gate.
risks.residual_risk: Approved service DNS, local listeners, network and configuration are privileged trust dependencies; application allowlisting does not prove DNS/host integrity.

risks.threat: Parallel requests, slow headers/bodies or oversized responses exhaust runtime/backend resources.
risks.origin: Parallel requests, slow headers/bodies or oversized responses exhaust runtime/backend resources.
controls: POST body streaming capped at 1 KiB/3 seconds; one provider call per process and one persisted processing reservation globally; spawned-process deadline; 8 KiB response cap, fixed context budget.
In-flight/latency/size metrics, 409/504, lease backlog and unavailable alerts.
preventive_controls: POST body streaming capped at 1 KiB/3 seconds; one provider call per process and one persisted processing reservation globally; spawned-process deadline; 8 KiB response cap, fixed context budget.
detective_controls: In-flight/latency/size metrics, 409/504, lease backlog and unavailable alerts.
risks.residual_risk: HTTP timeout does not instantly cancel already admitted thread/runtime work; host resource contention remains possible. No HA claim.

risks.threat: Authorized users repeatedly request new work or use read/capability as a generation trigger.
risks.origin: Authorized users repeatedly request new work or use read/capability as a generation trigger.
controls: Explicit POST only; shared ten-in-ten-minute limits for user and organization; persisted context/prompt/pin reuse; bounded maintenance and num_predict.
Correlated 429 audit, denials, generation counters and provider in-flight.
preventive_controls: Explicit POST only; shared ten-in-ten-minute limits for user and organization; persisted context/prompt/pin reuse; bounded maintenance and num_predict.
detective_controls: Correlated 429 audit, denials, generation counters and provider in-flight.
risks.residual_risk: Per-user/organization limits are not a daily CPU/energy quota; many authorized tenants and a compromised operator can consume resources.

risks.threat: Model produces a confident unsupported explanation and a user treats it as an operational decision.
risks.origin: Model produces a confident unsupported explanation and a user treats it as an operational decision.
controls: Counts/references/grounding/limitations validated; reject forbidden causal/executable wording; human-check notice; no automatic business changes.
Fallback/rejection codes and visible origin/limitations; final usefulness/quality gate remains #192.
preventive_controls: Counts/references/grounding/limitations validated; reject forbidden causal/executable wording; human-check notice; no automatic business changes.
detective_controls: Fallback/rejection codes and visible origin/limitations; final usefulness/quality gate remains #192.
risks.residual_risk: Lexical grounding is not a proof of semantic truth, explanation quality or user comprehension. Human review and #192 remain required.

risks.threat: Caller bypasses Angular menu and invokes POST, latest or probe directly.
risks.origin: Caller bypasses Angular menu and invokes POST, latest or probe directly.
controls: Session plus independent server-side execution/read/generate scopes; capability is informational; probe uses technical Bearer before network access.
403/404 authorization audit, confirmed scope signal, authentication errors and security regression.
preventive_controls: Session plus independent server-side execution/read/generate scopes; capability is informational; probe uses technical Bearer before network access.
detective_controls: 403/404 authorization audit, confirmed scope signal, authentication errors and security regression.
risks.residual_risk: Stolen valid session/technical token can exercise its legitimate scope until revocation; role visibility does not replace credential custody.

risks.threat: Process dies or HTTP times out and a retry races with old work.
risks.origin: Process dies or HTTP times out and a retry races with old work.
controls: Two-minute leases, unique processing reservation, context/prompt/pin reuse, stale UUID fencing; recover expired only after suspension and old workers ended.
Stalled/growing-expired alerts, recovered counter, atomic immutable maintenance audit and outbox.
preventive_controls: Two-minute leases, unique processing reservation, context/prompt/pin reuse, stale UUID fencing; recover expired only after suspension and old workers ended.
detective_controls: Stalled/growing-expired alerts, recovered counter, atomic immutable maintenance audit and outbox.
risks.residual_risk: Lease expiry cannot prove the old remote inference stopped; do not retry blindly or promise exactly-once inference under host failure.

risks.threat: Runtime or resources disappear while the core application remains usable.
risks.origin: Runtime or resources disappear while the core application remains usable.
controls: Optional feature and generation-only kill switch; reads require no provider; readiness depends only on core services; bounded informative probe.
Six HTTP outcomes, authenticated probe, unavailable alert and documented recovery exercise.
preventive_controls: Optional feature and generation-only kill switch; reads require no provider; readiness depends only on core services; bounded informative probe.
detective_controls: Six HTTP outcomes, authenticated probe, unavailable alert and documented recovery exercise.
risks.residual_risk: Shared host/database capacity can still affect the main application; a successful metadata probe does not guarantee inference quality or success.
